newsitem.title: USA: X-Rite Peabody's departure a mutual move.
newsitem.headline: X-Rite Peabody's departure a mutual move.

text.p: X-Rite Inc said Wednesday the departure of President Mat Peabody after seven months was mutally agreed.
"We just found ourselves incompatible," said Duane Kluting, chief financial officer, in an interview. "We just mutually agreed not to continue."
Peabody's resignation is effective immediately. Peabody has been investigating other job opportunities, but has not taken a position yet.
X-Rite will begin looking for a replacement shortly, Kluting said. The process was not expected to last as long as the nearly year-long search the preceded Peabody's hiring.
